'''Merumeru''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Wookiee]] [[chief]]tain and [[captain]] from the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]]. In the last [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Clone Wars]], he led a group of [[Wookiee warrior]]s into [[Battle of Kashyyyk|battle]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on his [[homeworld]].<ref name="Meru DB" /> Merumeru and his warriors fought on the beaches beneath the [[city]] of [[Kachirho]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> against the [[Separatist Droid Army]] and alongside [[clone trooper]]s of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Shortly after the battle, the Republic forces turned on the Wookiees during [[Order 66]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Personality and traits==
Merumeru was a [[Color|brown]]-[[Hair|furred]], 2.25-[[meter]]-tall Wookiee. He and his men were valiant fighters.<ref name="Meru DB" />

==Equipment==
As a chieftain, Merumeru wielded a wooden command staff.<ref name="Meru DB" /> During the Battle of Kashyyyk, he wore a [[Armor|helmet]], ornamented pauldrons, and a harness.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Merumeru was portrayed by actor [[Axel Dench]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] but identified only as "Wookiee Chieftain" during production.<ref name="db">{{DB|character|merumeru|Merumeru}}</ref> He was named in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[James Luceno]] and released in [[2005]].<ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The name was made [[canon]] by the reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'', which was released in [[2015]].<ref name="USW" />

The helmet Merumeru wore in ''Revenge of the Sith'' wasn't completed in time for production, so he wore a blue helmet. The blue headgear was later replaced with a digital helmet in the final version of the film.<ref name="db" />
